units: SI;60Hz accepted calls;4internal240Hz solver substeps per accepted call.

rules.startingPose: Identical stock-equilibrium origin, yaw 0, zero pitch/roll for each model; test-specific initial velocity.

straight.crossing: First 100 km/h crossing linearly interpolated between consecutive accepted horizontal speeds; null if not reached within 720 calls.

braking.policy: Full brake from declared exact initial horizontal speed to first accepted speed <=0.1 m/s. Report accepted path length and stop tick; no terminal pose assignment.

bump.geometry: h(z)=0.04*sin(pi*(-z-8)/4)^2 for -12<z<-8; h=0 elsewhere. Normal is normalized [0,1,-dh/dz].

rules.comparison: Straight/corner/steering/bump runs use identical complete timed command streams and explicit initial poses/velocities. Braking uses an identical deterministic stop policy with potentially different accepted lengths. Heading change sums shortest consecutive accepted heading differences to unwrap the reported angle.

mechanical.scope: Independent raw createVehicle engineering rigs. Exact-start braking and cosine-bump runs declare their own source-bound spawn velocities/surface; these are not user benchmarks or owned damage events.

practice.name: Free practice
practice.policy: Player commands; no money, settlement or persistent damage.

acceleration.name: 01 / Acceleration
acceleration.policy: Identical 900-call full-throttle tape; first 100 km/h crossing interpolates consecutive accepted horizontal-speed endpoints; null is valid non-completion.

braking.name: 02 / Braking
braking.policy: From rest, reference driver accelerates to the first accepted speed >=100 km/h, then applies full brake to <=0.1 m/s. Exact over-threshold starting speed and accepted path are reported. Manual inputs are separately labelled.

slalom.name: 03 / Slalom
slalom.policy: Pass six ordered finite forward timing gates inside the declared corridor. Reference driver follows the authored line at 8 m/s using recipe-aware pure pursuit and speed feedback.

handling.name: 04 / Constant-radius handling
handling.policy: Complete eight ordered radial timing gates around the 32 m reference circle within a +/-6 m corridor. Reference driver uses recipe-aware pure pursuit and 8 m/s speed feedback.

rules.independentObserver: Raw pinned createVehicle, source-derived starting pose, accepted command stream; independent speed/path/gate computations and complete solver-state equality.
rules.policy: All runs declare seed0. Acceleration uses identical900 full-throttle calls; other reference policies may produce different accepted commands between builds. No part-only causality claim is made for feedback lap times.

authority: No ownership mutation, purchase evidence, rewards or persistent damage. Browser controls separately certify purchased-car admission. Recreate long tapes from declared reference policy at this exact source and compare accepted command/full receipt hashes.

rawArtifact.serialization: JSON.stringify(result,null,2) followed by one LF at the declared exact source.
rawArtifact.retention: Lossless JSON field retention; leaf subtrees up to 1200 characters share a line. No measured field, canonical build, recipe, command identity, state hash or result is omitted.
